name: EarthMind-Bench
description: A benchmark suite focused on Earth- and environment-related knowledge and reasoning tasks for language models, collecting prompts and evaluation items across climate, ecology, and geoscience topics. It measures factual knowledge, domain-specific reasoning, and QA performance relevant to Earth sciences. The suite is intended to evaluate model capability on scientific environmental content rather than broad general-knowledge tasks.
reputation: A niche dataset on Hugging Face for evaluating environmental and Earth-science reasoning in LMs with limited community adoption so far.
